# Adobe Stock

> > Adobe Stock is a comprehensive marketplace for royalty-free creative assets including stock photos, vectors, illustrations, videos, and templates, with integrated Generative AI tools and contributor opportunities.

Adobe Stock provides millions of high-quality creative assets for designers, marketers, and content creators, seamlessly integrated with Adobe Creative Cloud applications like Photoshop. The platform offers curated collections, flexible pricing plans with free trials, and a contributor marketplace for creators to sell their work.

## Key Topics

- Royalty-free assets
- Stock photography
- Stock video footage
- Vector graphics
- Illustrations
- Generative AI
- Adobe Photoshop integration
- Creative Cloud
- Curated collections
- Contributor platform
- Creative assets licensing
- Templates and graphics
- Professional photography
- Digital art marketplace

## Core Asset Libraries

- [Stock Photos, royalty-free images, graphics, vectors & videos | Adobe Stock](https://stock.adobe.com/): Adobe Stock homepage offering millions of royalty-free creative assets
- [Stock Photos, Stock Photography & Royalty-Free Images | Adobe Stock](https://stock.adobe.com/photos): Browse professional stock photos and royalty-free photography collections
- [Stock Photos & Royalty-Free Images | Adobe Stock](https://stock.adobe.com/images): Explore stock photos, vectors, and royalty-free illustrations library
- [Royalty-Free Video Stock Footage, Unlimited Stock Video | Adobe Stock](https://stock.adobe.com/video): Search millions of royalty-free video clips and stock footage
- [Royalty-free Stock Illustrations | Adobe Stock](https://stock.adobe.com/illustrations): Browse royalty-free stock illustrations and digital art collections

## Plans & Pricing

- [Adobe Stock free trial - Get 10 Stock images free. | Adobe Stock](https://stock.adobe.com/plans): Pricing plans and free trial offering 10 standard stock assets

- [Best of Adobe Stock - Featured Collections | Adobe Stock](https://stock.adobe.com/collections): Curated collections featuring trending photos, vectors, and videos

## Contributors & Selling

- [Best Place to Sell Photos Online, Footage Clips, Illustrations, & Vectors – Adobe Stock](https://contributor.stock.adobe.com/): Contributor platform to sell creative work and earn royalties on Adobe Stock
